package.name: sidewalk_perception
package.description:
Phase 2 of the Mitacs sidewalk VSLAM project: bring the Stereolabs ZED X (SKU ZED-312110, GMSL2 via a ZED Link Quad capture card) online on the Jetson AGX Orin, and — more importantly — *prove* that the data it produces is trustworthy before any SLAM algorithm is allowed to consume it.
The package contains the camera launch configuration, a suite of sensor validation nodes (frame rate, dropped frames, timestamp jitter, IMU rate, frame_id correctness, depth validity), SVO2 record/playback wrappers so that every later phase can re-run on identical raw data, and a dataset manifest system that records exactly which hardware and software produced each recording.
package.author: Thaw Zin
